userStories.title: Add useNavigateFlow hook and migrate switchers to reset
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a single navigation hook that distinguishes push (linkflow) from reset (everything else) so stack semantics live in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: Add apps/web/src/hooks/use-navigate-flow.ts exporting pushLink, popBack, reset

userStories.notes: Landed apps/web/src/hooks/use-navigate-flow.ts with FlowStackEntry type, pure helpers (toFlowStackEntry, initialStackFromPath, computePushLink, computeResetStack, computePopState), effectful pushLink/popBack/reset, a reactive useFlowStack hook backed by useSyncExternalStore, and an idempotent ensureFlowNavigation() seed called from App.tsx module load. Module-level reactive store mirrors the stack into history.state.stackDepth so a popstate event reliably truncates without retaining cross-history refs. reset() pushState's a NEW entry when pathname differs from target; replaceState's (no new history entry) when it already matches — keeps depth synced after popstate-driven reconciliation. Popstate handler reads stackDepth + matchProjectFlow(pathname); when the truncated top mismatches, it calls reset(pathMatch) to forward-fix. Migrated call sites: Header logo (navigate('/') → reset(null)), ProjectSwitcher.navigateToProject, FlowSwitcher.onSelect, DemoView FlowCreate/Rename/Delete, StudioHome demo button, App.tsx pickInitialDemo redirect + projectOnly redirect + onUnregisterProject. All targets pass {project, flow} pairs to reset; the splug/flow split for FlowSummary.slug-bearing call sites uses a new splitFlowSlug helper in lib/router.ts. The stack stays at length 1 for now — no rendering changes (matchProjectFlow drives the project/flow that App.tsx threads through). project-switcher.test.tsx rewritten to stub globalThis.window instead of mock.module-ing @/hooks/use-navigate-flow (bun's mock.module is process-global and was clobbering use-navigate-flow.test.ts when both ran in the same process).
